instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-full shot from a low angle. In a gym setting with kettlebells on shelves and colorful medicine balls in the background, the woman in the grey t-shirt and khaki pants (R2) on the left and the man in the green hoodie and grey sweatpants (R1) on the right are bending forward at the waist. Both reach their hands toward the floor in a synchronized hamstring stretch, facing slightly toward each other. The indoor gym lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows on the black floor mat.
